## Rehearsal rules

- Protect the full 7:30 on slides 15–17; they are the technical center.
- If behind, compress slides 6–9 and 11–14.
- On slide 15, say that the NASA/JPL figures prove feasibility, not crew-scale readiness.
- On slides 16–17, identify the requirements and research request as illustrative work products awaiting reviewed runs.
- Pause after “Evidence decides what flies” on slide 10.
- End on “Model equals intelligence; harness equals mission capability.”

## Coverage checkpoints

- Slides 2–4: knowledge is not execution; the scope is physical engineering; skills outlast agent implementations.
- Slides 5–8: explain staged specialized harnesses, Hypatia’s validation loop, the O/D/A/U statuses and Intelligent Engineer’s phase gates.
- Slides 9–12: emphasize explicit work products, model-independent tools, ground-truth gates, human approval and durable mission memory including dissent and configuration state.
- Slides 15–17: keep observed MOXIE facts distinct from derived requirements, assumptions and unknowns.
- Slide 18: present eight portable skill contracts, not a new monolithic agent or a claim of platform equivalence.
- Slide 20: close on accountable physical action and a learning system that survives model generations.
